repairs.description: Correct sweep penetration measurement and admit wick-only liquidity sweeps with reclaim-candle confirmation.
repairs.logicSummary: range boundary liquidity sweep plus directional reclaim confirmation; corrected boundary-to-extreme penetration depth
repairs.rationale: v1 measured current-close-to-extreme distance and required an outside close, suppressing canonical wick reclaims and leaving only three OOS trades.

repairs.description: Expand bearish exhaustion samples while requiring a local high, directional impulse, and strong bearish confirmation.
repairs.logicSummary: local-high bullish exhaustion followed by bearish midpoint rejection and low-close confirmation
repairs.rationale: v2 used an overly rare 0.8 ATR single-candle threshold, ignored momentumPeriod, and produced only two OOS trades.

repairs.description: Accept upper-channel wick events while requiring a meaningful body extension and a bearish reclaim candle.
repairs.logicSummary: flat regression upper-channel wick rejection with bearish candle confirmation
repairs.rationale: v2 had positive validation and forward economics but only ten trades; brute-force threshold relaxation produced 47 unprofitable trades, so v3 broadens the event shape instead of lowering all filters.

repairs.description: Replace the full previous-low breakdown requirement with a bearish low-close confirmation candle after an upper-channel wick rejection.
repairs.logicSummary: flat regression upper-channel wick rejection followed by bearish low-close confirmation
repairs.rationale: v2 had profitable validation and forward windows but only nine trades; parameter-only broadening destroyed economics, so v3 broadens confirmation geometry while retaining the original wick and flat-channel filters.

repairs.description: Use the existing momentum period as local-low context and require a strong bullish reclaim after downside exhaustion.
repairs.logicSummary: local-low downside exhaustion followed by bullish midpoint reclaim and high-close confirmation
repairs.rationale: v1 ignored momentumPeriod and relied on a rare 0.55 ATR bearish body plus weak close-up confirmation, producing only seven OOS trades.

repairs.description: Accept a lower-band wick sweep in a compressed volatility regime and require a bullish close above the sweep bar high.
repairs.logicSummary: low-volatility lower Bollinger-band sweep followed by bullish full-range reentry
repairs.rationale: v2 had positive validation and forward economics but only eight trades; v3 expands event geometry without relaxing the volatility regime or bullish confirmation.

repairs.description: Allow a volume-confirmed breakout to retest within three bars and apply the volume condition to the breakout bar.
repairs.logicSummary: rising slow trend plus volume breakout and bullish retest within three bars
repairs.rationale: v2 won all observed OOS trades but only allowed a next-bar retest and incorrectly required elevated volume on the retest bar, leaving eight trades.
